title: Left-then-right rotation in an AVL tree
summary: For the zigzag path 3 → 1 → 2 that bends left and then right, first perform a left rotation on child (1) and then a right rotation on node (3), making 2 the new local root.
context: The outer root node is 4, with right child 5 and left child at the unbalanced node 3; node 3 has only left child 1, and node 1 has only right child 2. The figure labels unbalanced node 3 as node and its left child 1 as child.

A node's balance factor is its left subtree height minus its right subtree height, with leaf height 0 and empty subtree height −1; a tree is balanced only when every node's balance factor has absolute value at most 1. The balance factors below are computed from the connections shown.

By this definition, node (3) has balance factor 2, child (1) has −1, and outer root 4 also has balance factor 2. Rebalancing starts at the lowest unbalanced node, 3, which automatically restores balance at the outer root as well.
description: From left to right, the static figure shows three subfigures: before rotation, after the first rotation, and after the second rotation.

First rotation: perform a left rotation on child (node 1). Node 2 rises to become the root of this small subtree, node 1 moves down as the left child of 2, and node 3's left child becomes 2 accordingly. As shown in the middle subfigure, the bent path is straightened into the uniformly left-leaning path 3 → 2 → 1.

Second rotation: perform a right rotation on the originally unbalanced node, labeled node (3). Node 2 continues upward to become the root of the local subtree, node 3 moves down as the right child of 2, and node 1 remains the left child of 2. Outer parent node 4 updates its left child to 2 while keeping right child 5 unchanged.
result: After the two rotations, the entire tree is balanced again, and its inorder traversal sequence remains [1, 2, 3, 4, 5].

frames.title: Left-then-right rotation in an AVL tree
frames.explanation: For this left-right bent shape, applying a single right rotation directly to node 3 would still leave a new imbalance; only by first rotating left to convert the local shape into a same-side left-left slant, and then rotating right, are nodes 1, 2, and 3 distributed evenly on both sides.

steps.title: Identify the left-right imbalance at node 3
steps.explanation: Before rotation: outer root 4 connects to left 3 and right leaf node 5; 3 connects only to left 1, and 1 connects only to right leaf node 2. Orange node points to 3 with balance factor 2, blue child points to 1 with balance factor −1, and green grandchild is 2. The callout "Perform a left rotation on child" indicates resolving the left-right bend first.
steps.key_state: Initially, root 4 connects to left 3 and right 5; 3 connects to left 1, and 1 connects to right 2; node=3, child=1, ready to rotate 1 left first.
steps.announcement: Locate the left-right zigzag imbalance at node 3 and prepare a left rotation on left child 1 first.

steps.title: Complete the left rotation on node 1
steps.explanation: After rotating child (1) left, outer root 4 still connects to left 3 and right leaf node 5; 3 connects only to left 2, and 2 connects only to left leaf node 1. Green 2 rises and blue 1 moves down, turning the local subtree into the left chain 3→2→1. The callout changes to "Perform a right rotation on node", with a curved arrow indicating a right rotation on 3.
steps.key_state: After rotating 1 left, root 4 connects to left 3 and right 5; 3 connects to left 2, and 2 connects to left 1; next, rotate 3 right.
steps.announcement: Left rotation on node 1 complete: node 2 rises to become the left child of 3, ready for a right rotation on node 3.

steps.title: Complete the right rotation on node 3
steps.explanation: Next, rotate node (3) right: green 2 becomes the left child of outer root 4, while 4's right child remains 5; 2 connects to blue 1 on the left and orange 3 on the right, with 1, 3, and 5 all leaf nodes. Beside 2, the label "Balance restored" marks completion of the double rotation.
steps.key_state: After rotating 3 right, root 4 connects to left 2 and right 5; 2 connects to left 1 and right 3, balancing the whole tree.
steps.announcement: Perform a right rotation on node 3; node 2 takes over as subtree root, restoring balance to the entire tree.
